The bug was caused by the system not correctly managing parallel requests that involve intersecting hosts, leading to blocking issues where commands that should not block others (specifically background commands) were incorrectly treated as blocking. This was due to the absence of a mechanism to identify and differentiate background commands from regular commands in the existing codebase.
